result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your 20-week scan (anomaly scan) is booked. The scan checks how your baby is growing. It also looks for some physical conditions. The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do
1. Go to the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1, on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15.
2. If an interpreter would help you, call the clinic. Call at least 5 working days before your appointment. They will book one for free.
3. You may bring one adult with you.
4. You do not need a full bladder for this scan.
5. Do not bring children into the scan room. Children cannot come in.

## Dates and medicines
- Scan: Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15. Place: Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
- Interpreter: call at least 5 working days before 11 January 2027.
- Medicines: the letter lists none.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- How long will the scan take?
- Who can I bring with me?
- How will I get my scan results?

## When to get urgent help
Call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) on 01632 960 456 straight away. Do this if you have any of these before your appointment:
- any bleeding
- leaking fluid from your vagina
- severe tummy pain

The line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
